name: VAG DQ250-MQB / 0D9 6-speed DSG TCU
eeprom: external serial EEPROM on SSC0/SPI (per DQ250-MQB-Bench-Flash)

read_methods.notes: VW_Flash / mqb-flash-rs flash the CAL (0x20000) and ASW (0x130000) blocks over UDS on CAN (0x7E1/0x7E9) from an FRF/ODX container (DSG table cipher + LZSS) or a raw 0x180000-byte bin file; a full read uses the SBOOT bench path of DQ250-MQB-Bench-Flash (power-cycle window, RSA-1024 SBOOT check, uploaded flash manager). OpenTune has not validated either path on hardware.

vehicles.model: MQB-platform models with the 6-speed wet DSG

notes: MQB-generation DQ250 (software 0D9300xxx). Layout and checksum facts come from the open flashing tools cited below; OpenTune's dq250 JAMCRC is algorithm-vector + synthetic validated only - no real 0D9 dump was available. No pinout is given: no open source with a pin-level drawing for this unit was found, so none is guessed.
